title: PCR2 Setup
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the OT App before proceeding.

steps.title: Transfer indexes to wells
steps.instruction: Using fresh tips, transfer each index to its corresponding well in the PCR plate that already contains the sample.

steps.title: Add PCR2 buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add the PCR2 buffer to each well containing a sample and index, then mix the contents using fresh tips for each transfer.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select the labware JSON files (.json) to upload, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate the labware, tiprack, and pipette as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to execute the protocol.
